description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to password management within the SuiteCRM interface. It includes functions for password confirmation validation, setting password rules, validation against rules, and setting focus on form fields for user interaction.

methods.name: password_confirmation()
methods.description: Validates that the new password and confirmation match, updates UI styles accordingly, and flags if a password change is to be performed.

methods.name: set_password(form,rules)
methods.description: Validates form input for password change, ensuring rules are met and old/new passwords are entered correctly.

methods.name: newrules(minpwdlength,maxpwdlength,customregex)
methods.description: Checks the new password against length, character, and regex rules, updating the UI to reflect compliance.

methods.name: set_focus()
methods.description: Sets keyboard focus on relevant input fields when the page loads based on certain conditions.
